1. Home
Landing page — quick links into Programs, Phases and Exercises.

3. After clicking "Add Program"
A new program row is added and focused for rename; the full spreadsheet view takes over from here. Sized at 1920px to show the layout holds up on a wide desktop monitor — the sidebar stays fixed width, the sheet uses the extra room, and body copy stays capped for readability.

Exercises — before any are added
Same empty-state pattern as Programs.

Exercise library
Reached from the Exercises nav item. Programs picks exercise name + image from here instead of free text — see the open picker in step 3's "Bodyweight Squat" row.

Phases — before any are added
Same empty-state pattern as Programs and Exercises.

Phase library
Reached from the Phases nav item. Programs picks a session's phase from here instead of free text — see the open picker on the "Warm Up" row in step 3.
